The story concerns two separated parents, played by Maryana Spivak and Aleksey Rozin, whose loveless relationship has decayed into a state of bitterness and hostility.

happy as lazzaro.title: Happy as Lazzaro
happy as lazzaro.description: Happy As Lazzaro (Italian: Lazzaro Felice, lit. 'Happy Lazzaro') is a 2018 Italian magical realistic drama film written and directed by Alice Rohrwacher. It was selected to compete for the Palme d'Or at the 2018 Cannes Film Festival, where Rohrwacher won the award for Best Screenplay.

the great beauty.title: The Great Beauty
the great beauty.description: The Great Beauty (Italian: La grande bellezza) is a 2013 art drama film co-written and directed by Paolo Sorrentino. Filming took place in Rome starting on 9 August 2012. It premiered at the 2013 Cannes Film Festival where it was screened in competition for the Palme d'Or.

gomorrah.title: Gomorrah
gomorrah.description: Gomorrah (Italian: Gomorra) is a 2008 Italian crime drama film directed by Matteo Garrone, based on the non-fiction book of the same name by Roberto Saviano, who also collaborated in the screenplay.

il divo.title: Il Divo
il divo.description: Il divo (Italian pronunciation: [il ˈdiːvo], The Celebrity or more literally The Divine, from Latin divus, "god") is a 2008 Italian biographical drama film directed by Paolo Sorrentino. It is based on the figure of former Italian Prime Minister Giulio Andreotti.

le quattro volte.title: Le Quattro Volte
le quattro volte.description: Le quattro volte (English: "The Four Times") is an Italian film made in 2010. It depicts the concept of metempsychosis taking place in the remote mountain town of Caulonia, in southern Italy.

fire of love.title: Fire of Love
fire of love.description: Fire of Love is a 2022 independent documentary film about the lives and careers of volcanologists Katia and Maurice Krafft. Directed, written, and produced by Sara Dosa, the film had its world premiere at the 2022 Sundance Film Festival on January 20, 2022, where it won the Jonathan Oppenheim Editing Award.

all that breathes.title: All That Breathes
all that breathes.description: All That Breathes is a 2022 documentary film directed by Shaunak Sen. It is produced by Shaunak Sen, Aman Mann and Teddy Leifer under the banner of Rise Films. The film follows siblings Mohammad Saud and Nadeem Shehzad, who rescue and treat injured birds in India.

the brutalist.title: The Brutalist
the brutalist.description: The Brutalist is a 2024 epic period drama film directed and produced by Brady Corbet, who co-wrote the screenplay with Mona Fastvold. It stars Adrien Brody as a Jewish-Hungarian architect and severely traumatized Holocaust survivor who emigrates to the United States, where he struggles to recover and get his life back on track.

nickel boys.title: Nickel Boys
nickel boys.description: Nickel Boys is a 2024 American historical drama film based on the 2019 novel The Nickel Boys by Colson Whitehead. It was directed by RaMell Ross, who wrote the screenplay with Joslyn Barnes.

challengers.title: Challengers
challengers.description: Challengers is a 2024 romantic sports film directed by Luca Guadagnino and written by Justin Kuritzkes.

godland.title: Godland
godland.description: Godland (Icelandic: Volaða land, Danish: Vanskabte Land, lit. 'Malformed Land') is a 2022 drama film written and directed by Hlynur Pálmason.

saint omer.title: Saint Omer
saint omer.description: Saint Omer is a 2022 French legal drama film written and directed by Alice Diop, and starring Kayije Kagame and Guslagie Malanda. It is Diop's first narrative feature; her other films have been documentaries.

close.title: Close
close.description: Close () is a 2022 coming-of-age drama film directed by Lukas Dhont, co-written by Dhont and Angelo Tijssens, reteaming after their first feature film Girl (2018).

the souvenir.title: The Souvenir
the souvenir.description: The Souvenir is a 2019 romantic drama film written, directed, and co-produced by Joanna Hogg. The film is a semi-autobiographical account of Hogg's experiences at film school. It stars Honor Swinton Byrne, Tom Burke, and Tilda Swinton.

to each his own cinema.title: To Each His Own Cinema
to each his own cinema.director: David Lynch, Nanni Moretti, Gus Van Sant, Takeshi Kitano, Manoel de Oliveira, Roman Polanski, Thodoros Angelopoulos, Andrei Konchalovsky, Abbas Kiarostami, Alejandro González Iñárritu, Ken Loach, Wim Wenders, David Cronenberg, Zhang Yimou, Wong Kar-wai, Michael Cimino, Lars von Trier, Chen Kaige, Atom Egoyan, Jane Campion, Aki Kaurismäki, Claude Lelouch, Youssef Chahine, Bille August, Hou Hsiao-Hsien, Walter Salles, Raúl Ruiz, Amos Gitai, Olivier Assayas, Elia Suleiman, Tsai Ming-liang, Raymond Depardon, Luc Dardenne, Jean-Pierre Dardenne, Joel Coen, Ethan Coen
to each his own cinema.description: To Each His Own Cinema (French: Chacun son cinéma : une déclaration d'amour au grand écran) is a 2007 French comedy-drama anthology film commissioned for the 60th anniversary of the Cannes Film Festival. The film is a collection of 34 short films, each 3 minutes in length, by 36 acclaimed directors.

no regrets for our youth.title: No Regrets for Our Youth
no regrets for our youth.description: No Regrets for Our Youth (Japanese: わが青春に悔なし, Hepburn: Waga Seishun ni Kuinashi) is a 1946 Japanese film written and directed by Akira Kurosawa. It is based on the 1933 Takigawa incident, and is considered a quintessential "democratization film", taking up many themes associated with social policy under the early Occupation of Japan.

the bad sleep well.title: The Bad Sleep Well
the bad sleep well.description: The Bad Sleep Well (Japanese: 悪い奴ほどよく眠る, Hepburn: Warui Yatsu Hodo Yoku Nemuru; lit. 'The worse they are, the better they sleep') is a 1960 Japanese neo-noir crime mystery film directed by Akira Kurosawa. It was the first film to be produced under Kurosawa's own independent production company.

dreams.title: Dreams
dreams.description: Dreams (Japanese: 夢, Hepburn: Yume), also known as Akira Kurosawa's Dreams, is a 1990 magical realist anthology film of eight vignettes written and directed by Akira Kurosawa. Inspired by actual recurring dreams that Kurosawa had, it stars Akira Terao, Martin Scorsese, Chishū Ryū, Mieko Harada and Mitsuko Baisho.

one wonderful sunday.title: One Wonderful Sunday
one wonderful sunday.description: One Wonderful Sunday (Japanese: 素晴らしき日曜日, Hepburn: Subarashiki Nichiyōbi) is a 1947 Japanese film directed by Akira Kurosawa and co-written by Kurosawa and Keinosuke Uekusa. The film was produced by Sojiro Motoki for Toho and stars Chieko Nakakita and Isao Numazaki.

madadayo.title: Madadayo
madadayo.description: Madadayo (Japanese: まあだだよ, Hepburn: Mādadayo; lit. "Not Yet") is a 1993 Japanese comedy-drama film. It is the thirtieth and final film to be completed by Akira Kurosawa before his death. It was screened out of competition at the 1993 Cannes Film Festival.

rhapsody in august.title: Rhapsody in August
rhapsody in august.description: Rhapsody in August (Japanese: 八月の狂詩曲, Hepburn: Hachigatsu no rapusodī) is a 1991 Japanese drama film by Akira Kurosawa based on the novel Nabe no naka by Kiyoko Murata.

the world s most beautiful swindlers.title: The World's Most Beautiful Swindlers
the world s most beautiful swindlers.director: Roman Polanski, Jean-Luc Godard, Claude Chabrol, Ugo Gregoretti
the world s most beautiful swindlers.description: The World's Most Beautiful Swindlers (French: Les plus belles escroqueries du monde) is a 1964 crime comedy anthology film composed of five segments, each of which was created with a different set of writers, directors, and actors.

new york stories.title: New York Stories
new york stories.director: Woody Allen, Martin Scorsese, Francis Ford Coppola
new york stories.description: New York Stories is a 1989 American anthology film consisting of three segments with the central theme being New York City. The first is Life Lessons, directed by Martin Scorsese, written by Richard Price and starring Nick Nolte.

sanshiro sugata part ii.title: Sanshiro Sugata Part II
sanshiro sugata part ii.description: a. Judo Saga II) is a 1945 Japanese martial arts action drama film written and directed by Akira Kurosawa. The film is based on the novel by Tsuneo Tomita, son of Tomita Tsunejirō, the earliest disciple of judo.

the men who tread on the tiger s tail.title: The Men Who Tread on the Tiger's Tail
the men who tread on the tiger s tail.description: The Men Who Tread on the Tiger's Tail (Japanese: 虎の尾を踏む男達, Hepburn: Tora no O o Fumu Otokotachi) is a 1952 Japanese period drama film written and directed by Akira Kurosawa, based on the kabuki play Kanjinchō, which is in turn based on the Noh play Ataka.
the men who tread on the tiger s tail.wikipedia: The Men Who Tread on the Tiger's Tail

beyond the clouds.title: Beyond the Clouds
beyond the clouds.description: Beyond the Clouds (Italian: Al di là delle nuvole; French: Par-delà les nuages) is a 1995 anthology romance film directed by Michelangelo Antonioni and Wim Wenders, from a screenplay written by Antonioni, Wenders and Tonino Guerra.

the boy and the heron.title: The Boy and the Heron
the boy and the heron.description: The Boy and the Heron (Japanese: 君たちはどう生きるか, Hepburn: Kimitachi wa Dō Ikiru ka; lit.') is a 2023 Japanese animated fantasy film written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki. Produced by Studio Ghibli, the film's Japanese title references Genzaburō Yoshino's 1937 novel How Do You Live?

i live in fear.title: I Live in Fear
i live in fear.description: I Live in Fear (Japanese: 生きものの記録, Hepburn: Ikimono no Kiroku; lit. 'Record of a Living Being') is a 1955 Japanese drama film directed by Akira Kurosawa, produced by Sōjirō Motoki, and co-written by Kurosawa, Shinobu Hashimoto, and Hideo Oguni.

intolerable cruelty.title: Intolerable Cruelty
intolerable cruelty.description: Intolerable Cruelty is a 2003 American romantic comedy film directed, co-written and edited by Joel and Ethan Coen, and produced by Brian Grazer and the Coens. The script was written by Robert Ramsey and Matthew Stone and Ethan and Joel Coen, with the latter writing the last draft of the screenplay.

hail caesar.title: Hail, Caesar!
hail caesar.description: Hail, Caesar! is a 2016 comedy mystery film written, produced, edited, and directed by the brothers Joel and Ethan Coen.

scandal.title: Scandal
scandal.description: Scandal (Japanese: 醜聞, Hepburn: Sukyandaru; or Shūbun) is a 1950 Japanese drama film directed by Akira Kurosawa and written by Kurosawa and Ryūzō Kikushima, and stars Toshiro Mifune, Takashi Shimura, and Yoshiko Yamaguchi.

all these women.title: All These Women
all these women.description: All These Women (Swedish: För att inte tala om alla dessa kvinnor), originally released as Now About These Women in the UK, is a 1964 Swedish comedy film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman. It is a parody of Federico Fellini's 8½.

the ladykillers.title: The Ladykillers
the ladykillers.description: The Ladykillers is a 2004 American black comedy crime thriller film written, directed, produced and edited by Joel and Ethan Coen. The Coens' screenplay was based on the 1955 British Ealing comedy film of the same name, which was written by William Rose.

lumiere and company.title: Lumière and Company
lumiere and company.director: David Lynch, Arthur Penn, Spike Lee, James Ivory, Thodoros Angelopoulos, Andrei Konchalovsky, Abbas Kiarostami, John Boorman, Peter Greenaway, Wim Wenders, Zhang Yimou, Helma Sanders-Brahms, Michael Haneke, Patrice Leconte, Idrissa Ouédraogo, Jacques Rivette, Liv Ullmann, Nadine Trintignant, Claude Lelouch, Costa-Gavras, Alain Corneau, Youssef Chahine, Lasse Hallström, Fernando Trueba, Claude Miller, Bigas Luna, Cédric Klapisch, Hugh Hudson, Gabriel Axel, Sarah Moon, Vicente Aranda, Francis Girod, Ismail Merchant, Jerry Schatzberg, Régis Wargnier, Lucian Pintilie, Gaston Kaboré, Jaco Van Dormael, Merzak Allouache, Raymond Depardon, Yoshishige Yoshida
lumiere and company.description: Lumière and Company (original title: Lumière et compagnie) is a 1995 anthology film made in collaboration between forty-one international film directors. The project consists of short films made by each of the filmmakers using the original Cinématographe camera invented by the Auguste and Louis Lumière.

the french as seen by.title: The French as Seen By...
the french as seen by.director: David Lynch, Werner Herzog, Jean-Luc Godard, Luigi Comencini, Andrzej Wajda
the french as seen by.description: The French as Seen by... (Les Français vus par... in French) was the title and subject of a series of five short films by notable directors. It was initiated and sponsored by the newspaper Le Figaro, as part of the 1988 celebration of the tenth anniversary of its magazine section.

after the rehearsal.title: After the Rehearsal
after the rehearsal.description: After the Rehearsal (Swedish: Efter repetitionen) is a television film, written and directed by Ingmar Bergman in 1984. The script contains numerous quotes from Strindberg's A Dream Play. The film was screened out of competition at the 1984 Cannes Film Festival.

germany in autumn.title: Germany in Autumn
germany in autumn.director: Rainer Werner Fassbinder, Volker Schlöndorff, Alexander Kluge, Edgar Reitz, Alf Brustellin, Bernhard Sinkel, Beate Mainka-Jellinghaus, Katja Rupé, Hans-Peter Cloos, Maximiliane Mainka, Peter Schubert
germany in autumn.description: Germany in Autumn (German: Deutschland im Herbst) is a 1978 West German anthology film about the period of 1977 known as the German Autumn, which was dominated by incidents of terrorism.

the hudsucker proxy.title: The Hudsucker Proxy
the hudsucker proxy.description: The Hudsucker Proxy is a 1994 screwball comedy film co-written, produced, and directed by Joel and Ethan Coen. Sam Raimi co-wrote the script and served as second unit director.

face to face.title: Face to Face
face to face.description: Face to Face (Swedish: Ansikte mot ansikte) is a 1976 Swedish drama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman. It tells the story of a psychiatrist who is suffering from a mental illness. It stars Liv Ullmann and Erland Josephson.

the serpent s egg.title: The Serpent's Egg
the serpent s egg.description: The Serpent's Egg is a 1977 drama-mystery film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman and starring David Carradine and Liv Ullmann. The story is set in 1920s Berlin and features English and German dialogue.

the magic flute.title: The Magic Flute
the magic flute.description: The Magic Flute (Swedish: Trollflöjten) is Ingmar Bergman's 1975 film version of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's opera Die Zauberflöte. It was intended as a television production and was first shown on Swedish television on 1 January 1975, but was followed by a theatrical release later that year.

the passion of anna.title: The Passion of Anna
the passion of anna.description: The Passion of Anna (Swedish: En passion – "A passion") is a 1969 Swedish drama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman, who was awarded Best Director at the 1970 National Society of Film Critics Awards for the film.

from the life of the marionettes.title: From the Life of the Marionettes
from the life of the marionettes.description: From the Life of the Marionettes (German: Aus dem Leben der Marionetten) is a 1980 television film directed by Ingmar Bergman. The film was produced in West Germany with a German-language screenplay and soundtrack while Bergman was in "tax exile" from his native Sweden.
from the life of the marionettes.wikipedia: From the Life of the Marionettes

the touch.title: The Touch
the touch.description: The Touch (Swedish: Beröringen) is a 1971 romantic drama film directed and written by Ingmar Bergman and starring Max von Sydow, Bibi Andersson, Elliott Gould, and Sheila Reid. The film tells the story of an affair between a married woman and an impetuous foreigner.

sawdust and tinsel.title: Sawdust and Tinsel
sawdust and tinsel.description: Sawdust and Tinsel (Swedish: Gycklarnas afton, lit. 'Evening of the Jesters'; also released under the English titles Sunset of a Clown and The Naked Night) is a 1953 Swedish drama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman.

the rite.title: The Rite
the rite.description: The Rite (Swedish: Riten) is a 1969 Swedish drama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman. It premiered on Swedish television on 25 March 1969.

gangs of new york.title: Gangs of New York
gangs of new york.description: Gangs of New York is a 2002 epic historical drama film directed by Martin Scorsese and written by Jay Cocks, Steven Zaillian, and Kenneth Lonergan, based on Herbert Asbury's 1928 book The Gangs of New York.

love in the city.title: Love in the City
love in the city.director: Federico Fellini, Carlo Lizzani, Dino Risi, Francesco Maselli, Michelangelo Antonioni, Alberto Lattuada, Cesare Zavattini
love in the city.description: Love in the City (Italian: L'amore in città) is a 1953 Italian anthology film composed of six segments, each with its own director.

a woman is a woman.title: A Woman Is a Woman
a woman is a woman.description: A Woman Is a Woman (French: Une femme est une femme) is a 1961 experimental musical romantic comedy film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard, and starring Jean-Paul Belmondo, Anna Karina and Jean-Claude Brialy.

the magician.title: The Magician
the magician.description: Ansiktet (lit. 'The Face'), also released as The Magician, is a 1958 Swedish film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman, starring Max von Sydow and Ingrid Thulin. The plot follows a traveling magician named Albert Vogler, whose allegedly supernatural live shows are challenged by the skeptical population of a small village.

the quiet duel.title: The Quiet Duel
the quiet duel.description: The Quiet Duel (静かなる決闘, Shizukanaru Kettō) is a 1949 Japanese medical drama film directed by Akira Kurosawa from a screenplay he co-wrote with Senkichi Taniguchi.

summer interlude.title: Summer Interlude
summer interlude.description: Summer Interlude (Swedish: Sommarlek), originally titled Illicit Interlude in the United States, is a 1951 Swedish drama film co-written and directed by Ingmar Bergman. The film opened to highly positive reviews from critics.

secrets of women.title: Secrets of Women
secrets of women.description: Secrets of Women (Swedish: Kvinnors väntan), also known as Waiting Women, is a 1952 Swedish drama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman. The film, which was screened within the official selection of the Venice Film Festival in 1953, is centered on youthful relationships, told in flashbacks by a group of women.

the wrong man.title: The Wrong Man
the wrong man.description: The Wrong Man is a 1956 American docudrama film noir directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring Henry Fonda and Vera Miles.

eros.title: Eros
eros.director: Wong Kar-wai, Michelangelo Antonioni, Steven Soderbergh
eros.description: Eros is a 2004 anthology film consisting of three short segments: The Hand directed by Wong Kar-wai in Mandarin, Equilibrium by Steven Soderbergh in English, and The Dangerous Thread of Things by Michelangelo Antonioni in Italian.

the devil s eye.title: The Devil's Eye
the devil s eye.description: The Devil's Eye (Swedish: Djävulens öga) is a 1960 Swedish fantasy comedy film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman.

cosmopolis.title: Cosmopolis
cosmopolis.description: Cosmopolis is a 2012 drama film written, produced, and directed by David Cronenberg. It stars Robert Pattinson, Paul Giamatti, Samantha Morton, Sarah Gadon, Mathieu Amalric, Juliette Binoche, Jay Baruchel and Kevin Durand.

the most beautiful.title: The Most Beautiful
the most beautiful.description: The Most Beautiful (Japanese: 一番美しく, Hepburn: Ichiban Utsukushiku) is a 1944 Japanese drama and propaganda film written and directed by Akira Kurosawa. The semidocumentary film follows a group of female volunteer workers at an optics factory during the Second World War, during which the film was produced.

burn after reading.title: Burn After Reading
burn after reading.description: Burn After Reading is a 2008 black comedy espionage film written, produced, edited and directed by Joel and Ethan Coen. It follows a recently jobless CIA analyst, Osborne Cox (John Malkovich), whose misplaced memoirs are found by a pair of dimwitted gym employees (Frances McDormand and Brad Pitt).

boccaccio 70.title: Boccaccio '70
boccaccio 70.director: Federico Fellini, Luchino Visconti, Vittorio De Sica, Mario Monicelli
boccaccio 70.description: Boccaccio '70 is a 1962 comedy anthology film directed by Vittorio De Sica, Federico Fellini, Mario Monicelli and Luchino Visconti from an idea by Cesare Zavattini. It consists of four episodes, each by one of the directors, all about a different aspect of morality and love in modern times in the style of Giovanni Boccaccio.

m butterfly.title: M. Butterfly
m butterfly.description: M. Butterfly is a 1993 American romantic drama film directed by David Cronenberg and written by David Henry Hwang based on his 1988 play. The film stars Jeremy Irons and John Lone, with Ian Richardson, Barbara Sukowa, and Annabel Leventon.

the ballad of buster scruggs.title: The Ballad of Buster Scruggs
the ballad of buster scruggs.description: The Ballad of Buster Scruggs (titled on-screen as The Ballad of Buster Scruggs and Other Tales of the American Frontier) is a 2018 American Western black comedy anthology film written, directed, produced, and edited by the Coen brothers.

the tragedy of macbeth.title: The Tragedy of Macbeth
the tragedy of macbeth.description: The Tragedy of Macbeth is a 2021 American tragedy film written, directed and produced by Joel Coen, based on the play Macbeth by William Shakespeare. It is the first film directed by one of the Coen brothers without the other's involvement.

to joy.title: To Joy
to joy.description: To Joy (Swedish: Till glädje) is a 1950 Swedish film directed and written by Ingmar Bergman about a young married couple who play together in a Swedish orchestra.

saraband.title: Saraband
saraband.description: Saraband is a 2003 Swedish drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman, and his final film. It was made for Swedish television, but released theatrically in a longer cut outside Sweden. Its United States theatrical release, with English subtitles, was in July 2005.

the flavor of green tea over rice.title: The Flavor of Green Tea over Rice
the flavor of green tea over rice.description: Tea Over Rice or The Flavor of Green Tea over Rice (Japanese: お茶漬の味, Hepburn: Ochazuke no Aji) is a 1952 Japanese film directed by Yasujirō Ozu.
the flavor of green tea over rice.wikipedia: The Flavor of Green Tea over Rice

lincoln.title: Lincoln
lincoln.description: Lincoln is a 2012 American biographical film film directed and produced by Steven Spielberg, starring Daniel Day-Lewis as United States President Abraham Lincoln. The film features Sally Field, David Strathairn, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, James Spader, Hal Holbrook, and Tommy Lee Jones in supporting roles.

late autumn.title: Late Autumn
late autumn.description: Late Autumn (Japanese: 秋日和, Hepburn: Akibiyori; lit. 'A Calm Autumn Day') is a 1960 Japanese drama film directed by Yasujirō Ozu. It stars Setsuko Hara and Yoko Tsukasa as a mother and daughter, and is based on a story by Ton Satomi.

land of silence and darkness.title: Land of Silence and Darkness
land of silence and darkness.description: Land of Silence and Darkness (German: Land des Schweigens und der Dunkelheit) is a 1971 documentary film about deaf-blind people and their experience of life. The film was written, directed, and produced by Werner Herzog.

hook.title: Hook
hook.description: Hook is a 1991 American fantasy adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg and written by James V. Hart and Malia Scotch Marmo. It stars Robin Williams as Peter Banning / Peter Pan, Dustin Hoffman as Captain James Hook, Julia Roberts as Tinker Bell, Bob Hoskins as Mr.

amistad.title: Amistad
amistad.description: S. revenue cutter.S. Supreme Court in 1841. Morgan Freeman, Anthony Hopkins, and Matthew McConaughey star, along with Djimon Hounsou in his breakout role as Cinqué; Pete Postlethwaite, Nigel Hawthorne and Chiwetel Ejiofor appear in supporting roles.

port of call.title: Port of Call
port of call.description: Port of Call (Swedish: Hamnstad, lit. 'Port Town'; also known as Harbour City) is a 1948 Swedish drama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman. This film is strongly influenced by neorealism.

indiana jones and the kingdom of the cry.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
indiana jones and the kingdom of the cry.description: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull is a 2008 American action adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg, and written by David Koepp. It is the fourth installment in the Indiana Jones film series and a sequel to Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989).
indiana jones and the kingdom of the cry.wikipedia: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull

disclosure day.title: Disclosure Day
disclosure day.description: Disclosure Day is a 2026 American science fiction thriller film directed and produced by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp, based on a story by Spielberg. The film stars an ensemble cast, including Emily Blunt, Josh O'Connor, Colin Firth, Eve Hewson, and Colman Domingo.

the bride wore black.title: The Bride Wore Black
the bride wore black.description: The Bride Wore Black (French: La mariée était en noir, lit. 'The Bride Was in Black') is a 1968 psychological thriller film directed by François Truffaut from a screenplay he co-wrote with Jean-Louis Richard, based on the 1940 novel of the same name by William Irish, a pseudonym for Cornell Woolrich.

passion.title: Passion
passion.description: Passion (French: Passion) is a 1982 film by Jean-Luc Godard, the second full-length film made during his return to relatively mainstream filmmaking in the 1980s.

made in u s a.title: Made in U.S.A
made in u s a.description: A is a 1966 French crime comedy film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard, and starring Anna Karina, László Szabó, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Marianne Faithfull, Yves Afonso, and Jean-Claude Bouillon. It was a loose and unauthorized adaptation of the 1965 novel The Jugger by Richard Stark (an alias of Donald E.

the last temptation of christ.title: The Last Temptation of Christ
the last temptation of christ.description: The Last Temptation of Christ is a 1988 epic religious drama film directed by Martin Scorsese. Written by Paul Schrader, with uncredited rewrites from Scorsese and Jay Cocks, it is an adaptation of Nikos Kazantzakis' controversial 1955 novel of the same name.

paris je t aime.title: Paris, je t'aime
paris je t aime.director: Gus Van Sant, Alfonso Cuarón, Tom Tykwer, Gérard Depardieu, Wes Craven, Isabel Coixet, Gurinder Chadha, Richard LaGravenese, Alexander Payne, Christopher Doyle, Walter Salles, Sylvain Chomet, Olivier Assayas, Vincenzo Natali, Oliver Schmitz, Bruno Podalydès, Daniela Thomas, Frédéric Auburtin, Nobuhiro Suwa, Joel Coen, Ethan Coen
paris je t aime.description: Paris, je t'aime (French pronunciation: [paʁi ʒə tɛm]; lit. 'Paris, I Love You') is a 2006 anthology film starring an ensemble cast of actors of various nationalities. The two-hour film consists of eighteen short films set in different arrondissements (districts).

the post.title: The Post
the post.description: The Post is a 2017 American political thriller film about The Washington Post and the publication of the Pentagon Papers. It was directed and produced by Steven Spielberg, and written by Liz Hannah and Josh Singer.

the lost world jurassic park.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
the lost world jurassic park.description: The Lost World: Jurassic Park is a 1997 American science fiction action film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp. It is the second film in the Jurassic Park franchise and the original Jurassic Park trilogy, and is loosely based on Michael Crichton's 1995 novel The Lost World.

war of the worlds.title: War of the Worlds
war of the worlds.description: War of the Worlds is a 2005 American science fiction and action thriller film directed by Steven Spielberg and written by Josh Friedman and David Koepp, based on H. G. Wells' 1898 novel, The War of the Worlds.

the bfg.title: The BFG
the bfg.description: The BFG (titled onscreen as Roald Dahl's The BFG) is a 2016 fantasy adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg, written by Melissa Mathison, and based on the 1982 novel. The film stars Mark Rylance, Ruby Barnhill, Penelope Wilton, Jemaine Clement, Rebecca Hall, Rafe Spall, and Bill Hader.

catch me if you can.title: Catch Me If You Can
catch me if you can.description: Catch Me If You Can is a 2002 American comedy-drama film directed and produced by Steven Spielberg and starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks with Christopher Walken, Martin Sheen, Nathalie Baye, Amy Adams and James Brolin in supporting roles.

war horse.title: War Horse
war horse.description: War Horse is a 2011 war drama film directed and produced by Steven Spielberg, from a screenplay written by Lee Hall and Richard Curtis. It is based on Michael Morpurgo's 1982 novel and its 2007 stage adaptation.

early spring.title: Early Spring
early spring.description: Early Spring (早春, Sōshun) is a 1956 Japanese film by Yasujirō Ozu and starring Chikage Awashima, Ryō Ikebe and Keiko Kishi. It is about a married salaryman who escapes the monotony of married life and his work at a fire brick manufacturing company by beginning an affair with a fellow office worker.

indiana jones and the last crusade.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
indiana jones and the last crusade.description: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade is a 1989 American action-adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by Jeffrey Boam, based on a story by George Lucas and Menno Meyjes. It is the third installment in the Indiana Jones film series and the narrative sequel to Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981).
indiana jones and the last crusade.wikipedia: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

the trouble with harry.title: The Trouble with Harry
the trouble with harry.description: The Trouble with Harry is a 1955 American Technicolor black comedy film directed by Alfred Hitchcock. The screenplay by John Michael Hayes was based on the 1949 novel of the same name by Jack Trevor Story.

six in paris.title: Six in Paris
six in paris.director: Éric Rohmer, Jean-Luc Godard, Claude Chabrol, Jean Rouch, Jean Douchet, Jean-Daniel Pollet
six in paris.description: , lit.') is a 1965 French comedy-drama anthology film.

bridge of spies.title: Bridge of Spies
bridge of spies.description: Bridge of Spies is a 2015 historical drama film directed and co-produced by Steven Spielberg, written by Matt Charman and the Coen brothers, and starring Tom Hanks in the lead role, Mark Rylance, Amy Ryan, and Alan Alda.

the terminal.title: The Terminal
the terminal.description: The Terminal is a 2004 American comedy-drama film produced and directed by Steven Spielberg and starring Tom Hanks, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Stanley Tucci. The film is about an Eastern European man who is stuck in New York's John F.

far from vietnam.title: Far from Vietnam
far from vietnam.director: Jean-Luc Godard, Chris Marker, Alain Resnais, Agnès Varda, Joris Ivens, Claude Lelouch, William Klein
far from vietnam.description: Far from Vietnam (French: Loin du Vietnam) is a 1967 French documentary film directed by Joris Ivens, William Klein, Claude Lelouch, Agnès Varda, Jean-Luc Godard, Chris Marker and Alain Resnais.

wrong move.title: Wrong Move
wrong move.description: Wrong Move (German: Falsche Bewegung – "False Movement") is a 1975 German road movie directed by Wim Wenders. This was the second part of Wenders' "Road Movie trilogy" which included Alice in the Cities (1974) and Kings of the Road (1976).

the adventures of tintin.title: The Adventures of Tintin
the adventures of tintin.description: The Adventures of Tintin (released as The Adventures of Tintin: The Secret of the Unicorn in some territories) is a 2011 animated adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg, who produced it with Peter Jackson and Kathleen Kennedy, and written by Steven Moffat, Edgar Wright and Joe Cornish.

kundun.title: Kundun
kundun.description: Kundun is a 1997 American epic biographical film written by Melissa Mathison and directed by Martin Scorsese. It is based on the life and writings of the 14th Dalai Lama Tenzin Gyatso (known also as Kundun), the exiled political and spiritual leader of Tibet.

the oldest profession.title: The Oldest Profession
the oldest profession.director: Jean-Luc Godard, Mauro Bolognini, Michael Pfleghar, Philippe de Broca, Claude Autant-Lara, Franco Indovina
the oldest profession.description: The Oldest Profession (French: Le Plus Vieux Métier du monde) is a 1967 internationally co-produced comedy film. It features contributions from six different film directors, each one doing a segment on prostitution through the ages.

tokyo twilight.title: Tokyo Twilight
tokyo twilight.description: Tokyo Twilight (東京暮色, Tōkyō boshoku) is a 1957 Japanese drama film by Yasujirō Ozu starring Ineko Arima and Setsuko Hara. It was written by Ozu and Kōgo Noda, and is Ozu's last film shot in black and white.

honey don t.title: Honey Don't!
honey don t.description: Honey Don't! is a 2025 neo-noir black comedy film directed by Ethan Coen, who co-wrote the screenplay with his wife Tricia Cooke. It is the second in a "lesbian B-movie trilogy" following Coen and Cooke's Drive-Away Dolls (2024).

indiana jones and the temple of doom.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
indiana jones and the temple of doom.description: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom is a 1984 American action-adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg from a script by Willard Huyck and Gloria Katz, based on a story by George Lucas. It is the second installment in the Indiana Jones film series and a prequel to Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark.
indiana jones and the temple of doom.wikipedia: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

the aviator.title: The Aviator
the aviator.description: The Aviator is a 2004 epic biographical drama film directed by Martin Scorsese and written by John Logan. It stars Leonardo DiCaprio as Howard Hughes, Cate Blanchett as Katharine Hepburn, and Kate Beckinsale as Ava Gardner.

the great ecstasy of woodcarver steiner.title: The Great Ecstasy of Woodcarver Steiner
the great ecstasy of woodcarver steiner.description: The Great Ecstasy of Woodcarver Steiner (German: Die große Ekstase des Bildschnitzers Steiner) is a 1974 documentary film by German filmmaker Werner Herzog. It is about Walter Steiner, a celebrated ski jumper of his era who worked as a carpenter for his full-time occupation.
the great ecstasy of woodcarver steiner.wikipedia: The Great Ecstasy of Woodcarver Steiner

the wolf of wall street.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
the wolf of wall street.description: The Wolf of Wall Street is a 2013 American epic biographical dark comedy crime film co-produced and directed by Martin Scorsese, written by Terence Winter, and based on Jordan Belfort's 2007 memoir.
the wolf of wall street.wikipedia: The Wolf of Wall Street (2013 film)

dreams 1955.title: Dreams
dreams 1955.description: Dreams (Swedish: Kvinnodröm) is a 1955 Swedish drama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman.

roma 1972.title: Roma
roma 1972.description: Roma (also known as Fellini's Roma or Federico Fellini's Roma) is a 1972 semi-autobiographical comedy-drama film depicting director Federico Fellini's move from his native Rimini to Rome as a youth. The film was directed by Fellini from a screenplay by himself and Bernardino Zapponi.

stimulantia.title: Stimulantia
stimulantia.director: Ingmar Bergman, Vilgot Sjöman, Jörn Donner, Hans Alfredson, Gustaf Molander, Tage Danielsson, Hans Abramson, Arne Arnbom, Lars Görling
stimulantia.description: Stimulantia is a 1967 Swedish anthology film written and directed by Hans Abramson, Hans Alfredson, Arne Arnbom, Tage Danielsson, Lars Görling, Ingmar Bergman, Jörn Donner, Gustaf Molander, and Vilgot Sjöman.

in the presence of a clown.title: In the Presence of a Clown
in the presence of a clown.description: In the Presence of a Clown (Swedish: Larmar och gör sig till) is a television film by Ingmar Bergman, recorded for Swedish television in 1997 with Bergman as a director. It was screened in the Un Certain Regard section of the 1998 Cannes Film Festival.
in the presence of a clown.wikipedia: In the Presence of a Clown

the munekata sisters.title: The Munekata Sisters
the munekata sisters.description: The Munekata Sisters (宗方姉妹, Munekata shimai) is a 1950 Japanese drama film directed by Yasujirō Ozu and starring Kinuyo Tanaka and Hideko Takamine. It is based on a novel by Jirō Osaragi.

the scarlet letter.title: The Scarlet Letter
the scarlet letter.description: The Scarlet Letter (German: Der Scharlachrote Buchstabe) is a 1973 period drama film directed by Wim Wenders, based on Nathaniel Hawthorne's 1850 novel of the same name. The West German-Spanish co-production stars Senta Berger as Hester Prynne, Lou Castel as Reverend Dimmesdale, and Hans Christian Blech as Chillingworth.

spirits of the dead.title: Spirits of the Dead
spirits of the dead.director: Federico Fellini, Louis Malle, Roger Vadim
spirits of the dead.description: Spirits of the Dead (French: Histoires extraordinaires, lit. 'Extraordinary Tales', Italian: Tre passi nel delirio, lit.

il bidone.title: Il bidone
il bidone.description: a. The Swindle, is a 1955 Italian drama film directed by Federico Fellini starring Broderick Crawford, Richard Basehart and Giulietta Masina.

the three faces.title: The Three Faces
the three faces.director: Mauro Bolognini, Michelangelo Antonioni, Franco Indovina
the three faces.description: The Three Faces (Italian: I tre volti) is a 1965 Italian anthology film consisting of three segments directed by Michelangelo Antonioni, Mauro Bolognini, and Franco Indovina, starring Soraya either as herself or in fictitious roles.

fellini s casanova.title: Fellini's Casanova
fellini s casanova.description: Fellini's Casanova (Italian: Il Casanova di Federico Fellini, lit. 'The Casanova by Federico Fellini') is a 1976 Italian film directed by Federico Fellini from a screenplay he co-wrote with Bernardino Zapponi, adapted from the autobiography of 18th-century Venetian adventurer and writer Giacomo Casanova, played by Donald Sutherland.

fellini a director s notebook.title: Fellini: A Director's Notebook
fellini a director s notebook.description: Fellini: A Director's Notebook (Italian: Bloc-notes di un regista) is an Italian documentary for television directed by Federico Fellini shot in 16mm and first broadcast in the United States on NBC in 1969, on NBC Experiment in Television.

la soufriere.title: La Soufrière
la soufriere.description: La Soufrière – Warten auf eine unausweichliche Katastrophe ("La Soufrière – Waiting for an Inevitable Disaster") is a 1977 documentary film in which German director Werner Herzog visits an evacuated town on the island of Guadeloupe, where the volcano La Grande Soufrière is predicted to erupt.

two or three things i know about her.title: Two or Three Things I Know About Her
two or three things i know about her.description: Two or Three Things I Know About Her (French: Deux ou trois choses que je sais d'elle) is a 1967 French New Wave film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard, one of three features he completed that year. As with the other two (La Chinoise and Weekend), it is considered both socially and stylistically radical.
two or three things i know about her.wikipedia: Two or Three Things I Know About Her

woyzeck.title: Woyzeck
woyzeck.description: Woyzeck [ˈvɔʏtsɛk] is a 1979 West German drama film written, produced and directed by Werner Herzog, and starring Klaus Kinski and Eva Mattes. It is an adaptation of German dramatist Georg Büchner's unfinished play of the same name.

the white sheik.title: The White Sheik
the white sheik.description: The White Sheik (Italian: Lo sceicco bianco) is a 1952 Italian romantic comedy film directed by Federico Fellini and starring Alberto Sordi, Leopoldo Trieste, Brunella Bovo and Giulietta Masina.

always.title: Always
always.description: Always is a 1989 American romantic fantasy film directed and produced by Steven Spielberg. It is a remake of the 1943 romantic drama A Guy Named Joe, which was set during World War II. The main departure from the 1943 film is changing the setting from wartime to a modern aerial firefighting operation.

signs of life.title: Signs of Life
signs of life.description: Signs of Life (German: Lebenszeichen) is a 1968 feature film written, directed, and produced by Werner Herzog. It was his first feature film, and his first major commercial and critical success. The story is roughly based on the short story "Der Tolle Invalide auf dem Fort Ratonneau" by Achim von Arnim.

maps to the stars.title: Maps to the Stars
maps to the stars.description: Maps to the Stars is a 2014 satirical black comedy film directed by David Cronenberg, and starring Julianne Moore, Mia Wasikowska, John Cusack, Robert Pattinson, Olivia Williams, Sarah Gadon, and Evan Bird.

invincible.title: Invincible
invincible.description: Invincible (German: Unbesiegbar) is a 2001 biographical historical drama film written, produced and directed by Werner Herzog. It is a fictionalized account of the lives of Zishe Breitbart, a Jewish strongman in early 20th-century Berlin, and Erik Jan Hanussen, a self-proclaimed mystic and clairvoyant.

drive away dolls.title: Drive-Away Dolls
drive away dolls.description: Drive-Away Dolls (alternately titled onscreen as Henry James' Drive-Away Dykes) is a 2024 crime comedy road film directed by Ethan Coen from a screenplay he co-wrote with his wife Tricia Cooke, who was also the film's editor and uncredited co-director.

hugo.title: Hugo
hugo.description: Hugo is a 2011 American adventure drama film directed and produced by Martin Scorsese, and adapted for the screen by John Logan.

where the green ants dream.title: Where the Green Ants Dream
where the green ants dream.description: Where the Green Ants Dream (German: Wo die grünen Ameisen träumen) is a 1984 English-language West German film directed and co-written by Werner Herzog, made in Australia.

crisis.title: Crisis
crisis.description: Crisis (Swedish: Kris) is a 1946 Swedish melodrama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman (in his directorial debut), based on the Danish radio play Moderhjertet (translated as The Mother Animal, A Mother's Heart, The Mother Creature, and The Maternal Instinct) by Leck Fischer.

a lesson in love.title: A Lesson in Love
a lesson in love.description: A Lesson in Love (Swedish: En lektion i kärlek) is a 1954 Swedish comedy film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman. The film is about the marriage of a gynecologist named David and his wife Marianne. The film's score was composed by Dag Wirén.

and the ship sails on.title: And the Ship Sails On
and the ship sails on.description: And the Ship Sails On (Italian: E la nave va) is a 1983 Italian film directed and co-written by Federico Fellini. It depicts the events on board a luxury liner filled with the friends of a deceased opera singer who have gathered to mourn her.

spider.title: Spider
spider.description: Spider is a 2002 psychological thriller film produced and directed by David Cronenberg and based on the 1990 novel of the same name by Patrick McGrath, who also wrote the screenplay.

eastern promises.title: Eastern Promises
eastern promises.description: Eastern Promises is a 2007 gangster crime thriller film directed by David Cronenberg and written by Steven Knight.

a dangerous method.title: A Dangerous Method
a dangerous method.description: A Dangerous Method is a 2011 historical drama film directed by David Cronenberg. The film stars Keira Knightley, Viggo Mortensen, Michael Fassbender, Sarah Gadon, and Vincent Cassel.

the carabineers.title: The Carabineers
the carabineers.description: The Carabineers (French: Les Carabiniers) is a 1963 French war comedy-drama film by French filmmaker Jean-Luc Godard.

a hen in the wind.title: A Hen in the Wind
a hen in the wind.description: A Hen in the Wind (風の中の牝鶏, Kaze no naka no mendori) is a 1948 Japanese drama film directed by Yasujirō Ozu, starring Kinuyo Tanaka and Shūji Sano. It was written by Ozu and Ryosuke Saito.

orchestra rehearsal.title: Orchestra Rehearsal
orchestra rehearsal.description: Orchestra Rehearsal (Italian: Prova d'orchestra) is a 1978 satirical film directed by Federico Fellini. It follows an Italian orchestra as the members go on strike against the conductor. The film was shown out of competition at the 1979 Cannes Film Festival.

i confess.title: I Confess
i confess.description: I Confess is a 1953 American film noir directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Montgomery Clift as Catholic priest Father Michael William Logan, Anne Baxter as Ruth Grandfort, and Karl Malden as Inspector Larrue.

love at twenty.title: Love at Twenty
love at twenty.director: Shintarō Ishihara, François Truffaut, Andrzej Wajda, Marcel Ophuls, Renzo Rossellini
love at twenty.description: Love at Twenty (French: L'Amour à vingt ans, Japanese: 二十歳の恋, romanized: Hatachi no koi, Italian: L'amore a vent'anni, German: Liebe mit zwanzig, Polish: Miłość dwudziestolatków) is a 1962 French-produced omnibus project of Pierre Roustang, consisting of five segments, each with a different director from a different country.

the clowns.title: The Clowns
the clowns.description: The Clowns (Italian: I clowns, also known as I pagliacci) is a 1970 mockumentary film by Federico Fellini about the human fascination with clowns and circuses.

empire of the sun.title: Empire of the Sun
empire of the sun.description: Empire of the Sun is a 1987 American war drama film directed by Steven Spielberg and written by Tom Stoppard, based on J. G. Ballard's semi-autobiographical 1984 novel of the same name.

brothers and sisters of the toda family.title: Brothers and Sisters of the Toda Family
brothers and sisters of the toda family.description: Brothers and Sisters of the Toda Family (Japanese: 戸田家の兄妹, Hepburn: Toda-ke no kyōdai) is a 1941 Japanese drama film directed by Yasujirō Ozu.
brothers and sisters of the toda family.wikipedia: Brothers and Sisters of the Toda Family

there was a father.title: There Was a Father
there was a father.description: There Was a Father (Japanese: 父ありき, Hepburn: Chichi Ariki) is a 1942 Japanese film directed by Yasujirō Ozu.

the soft skin.title: The Soft Skin
the soft skin.description: The Soft Skin (French: La peau douce) is a 1964 romantic drama film directed by François Truffaut and starring Jean Desailly, Françoise Dorléac and Nelly Benedetti. Written by Truffaut and Jean-Louis Richard, it follows a married successful writer and lecturer who meets and has an affair with a flight attendant half his age.

the fabelmans.title: The Fabelmans
the fabelmans.description: The Fabelmans is a 2022 American coming-of-age drama film directed and co-produced by Steven Spielberg, who co-wrote the screenplay with Tony Kushner.

last words.title: Last Words
last words.description: Last Words (German: Letzte Worte) is a 1968 short film by Werner Herzog shot in Crete and on the island of Spinalonga. The film was shot in two days during the filming of Herzog's feature Signs of Life, and edited in one day.

the flying doctors of east africa.title: The Flying Doctors of East Africa
the flying doctors of east africa.description: The Flying Doctors of East Africa (German: Die Fliegenden Ärzte von Ostafrika) is a 1969 documentary film by Werner Herzog about the "flying doctors" service of the African Medical and Research Foundation in Tanzania and Kenya.
the flying doctors of east africa.wikipedia: The Flying Doctors of East Africa

ginger and fred.title: Ginger and Fred
ginger and fred.description: Ginger and Fred (Italian: Ginger e Fred) is a 1986 comedy-drama film written and directed by Federico Fellini and starring Marcello Mastroianni and Giulietta Masina. The title is a reference to the American dancing couple Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers.

fata morgana.title: Fata Morgana
fata morgana.description: Fata Morgana is a 1971 film by Werner Herzog, shot in 1968 and 1969, which captures mirages in the Sahara and Sahel deserts. Herzog also wrote the narration by Lotte H. Eisner, which recounts the Mayan creation myth, the Popol Vuh.

the crucified lovers.title: The Crucified Lovers
the crucified lovers.description: The Crucified Lovers (Japanese: 近松物語, Hepburn: Chikamatsu Monogatari), also titled A Story from Chikamatsu, is a 1954 Japanese drama film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi. It was adapted from Monzaemon Chikamatsu's 1715 bunraku play Daikyōji mukashi goyomi.

beware of a holy whore.title: Beware of a Holy Whore
beware of a holy whore.description: Beware of a Holy Whore (German: Warnung vor einer heiligen Nutte) is a 1971 West German drama film written and directed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder that features Lou Castel, Eddie Constantine, Hanna Schygulla and Fassbinder himself.

the color of money.title: The Color of Money
the color of money.description: The Color of Money is a 1986 American sports drama film directed by Martin Scorsese. It is the sequel to the 1961 film The Hustler. Like the previous film, The Color of Money is based on a novel by Walter Tevis.

the godfather part iii.title: The Godfather Part III
the godfather part iii.description: The Godfather Part III is a 1990 American epic gangster film produced and directed by Francis Ford Coppola from the screenplay co-written with Mario Puzo. The film stars Al Pacino, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, Andy García, Eli Wallach, Joe Mantegna, Bridget Fonda, George Hamilton and Sofia Coppola.

aria.title: Aria
aria.director: Nicolas Roeg, Jean-Luc Godard, Robert Altman, Ken Russell, Derek Jarman, Franc Roddam, Bruce Beresford, Julien Temple, Charles Sturridge, Bill Bryden
aria.description: Aria is a 1987 British anthology film produced by Don Boyd that consists of ten short films by ten different filmmakers, each showing the director's choice of visual accompaniment to one or more operatic arias.

summer in the city.title: Summer in the City
summer in the city.description: Summer in the City is the first full-length feature film by director Wim Wenders, released in 1970 and starring Hanns Zischler. Wenders' first full-length film was produced as his graduation project at the University of Television and Film Munich ("Hochschule für Fernsehen und Film München") which he attended from 1967 to 1970.

lightning over water.title: Lightning Over Water
lightning over water.description: Lightning Over Water, also known as Nick's Film, is a 1980 West German-Swedish documentary-drama film written, directed by and starring Wim Wenders and Nicholas Ray. It centers on the last days of Ray's own life, who was already known worldwide for his 1955 classic film Rebel Without a Cause.

a married woman.title: A Married Woman
a married woman.description: A Married Woman (French: Une femme mariée) is a 1964 French drama film directed by Jean-Luc Godard, his eighth feature film.

whity.title: Whity
whity.description: Whity is a 1971 West German film, written and directed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder and starring Günther Kaufmann and Hanna Schygulla.

the sugarland express.title: The Sugarland Express
the sugarland express.description: The Sugarland Express is a 1974 American crime drama film directed by Steven Spielberg. The film follows a woman (Goldie Hawn) and her husband (William Atherton) as they take a police officer (Michael Sacks) hostage and flee across Texas while they try to get to their child before he is placed in foster care.

it rains on our love.title: It Rains on Our Love
it rains on our love.description: It Rains on Our Love (Swedish: Det regnar på vår kärlek) is a 1946 Swedish drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman from a screenplay he co-wrote with Herbert Grevenius, based on the Norwegian play Bra Mennesker (Good People) by Oskar Braaten.

a ship bound for india.title: A Ship Bound for India
a ship bound for india.description: A Ship Bound for India (Swedish: Skepp till Indialand) is a 1947 Swedish melodrama film written and directed by Ingmar Bergman, based on the play by Martin Söderhjelm. It was originally released as A Ship to India in the United Kingdom and Frustration in the United States.

music in darkness.title: Music in Darkness
music in darkness.description: Music in Darkness (Swedish: Musik i mörker), known in the United States as Night Is My Future, is a 1948 Swedish drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman from a screenplay he co-wrote with Dagmar Edqvist, based on Edqvist's novel of the same name.

prison.title: Prison
prison.description: Prison (Swedish: Fängelse), also known as The Devil's Wanton in the United States, is a 1949 Swedish drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman. It is the earliest film directed by Bergman to be based on his own original screenplay.

piece of the sky.title: Piece of the Sky
piece of the sky.description: Piece of the Sky (Italian: Un ettaro di cielo) is a 1958 Italian comedy film directed by Aglauco Casadio.

the decalogue.title: The Decalogue
the decalogue.description: Dekalog (pronounced [dɛˈkalɔk], also known as Dekalog: The Ten Commandments and The Decalogue) is a 1989 Polish psychological drama television miniseries directed by Krzysztof Kieślowski and co-written by Kieślowski with Krzysztof Piesiewicz, with music by Zbigniew Preisner.

love and anger.title: Love and Anger
love and anger.director: Pier Paolo Pasolini, Carlo Lizzani, Jean-Luc Godard, Bernardo Bertolucci, Marco Bellocchio
love and anger.description: Amore e rabbia (Love and Anger) is a 1969 Italian-French anthology film that includes five films directed by four Italian directors and one French director. It premiered at the 19th Berlin International Film Festival in 1969, with the title Vangelo '70.

from up on poppy hill.title: From Up on Poppy Hill
from up on poppy hill.description: From Up on Poppy Hill (Japanese: コクリコ坂から, Hepburn: Kokuriko-zaka Kara; lit.

le petit soldat.title: Le Petit Soldat
le petit soldat.description: Le petit soldat (transl. The Little Soldier) is a French film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard in 1960, but its release was delayed until 1963 by censorship. It was the first project on which Godard worked with Anna Karina, who stars alongside Michel Subor, but the third to be released.

ro go pa g.title: Ro.Go.Pa.G.
ro go pa g.director: Pier Paolo Pasolini, Jean-Luc Godard, Roberto Rossellini, Ugo Gregoretti
ro go pa g.description: G. (also known as "RoGoPaG") is a 1963 film consisting of four segments, each written and directed by a different director.

my blueberry nights.title: My Blueberry Nights
my blueberry nights.description: My Blueberry Nights is a 2007 romantic drama film directed by Wong Kar-wai, his first feature in English. The screenplay by Wong and Lawrence Block is based on a Chinese-language short film written and directed by Wong.

the dead zone.title: The Dead Zone
the dead zone.description: The Dead Zone is a 1983 American science fiction thriller film directed by David Cronenberg. The screenplay, by Jeffrey Boam, is based on the 1979 novel of the same title by Stephen King. The film stars Christopher Walken, Brooke Adams, Tom Skerritt, Herbert Lom, Martin Sheen, Anthony Zerbe, and Colleen Dewhurst.

my best fiend.title: My Best Fiend
my best fiend.description: My Best Fiend (German: Mein liebster Feind - Klaus Kinski, literally My Dearest Foe - Klaus Kinski) is a 1999 German documentary film written and directed by Werner Herzog, about his tumultuous yet productive relationship with German actor Klaus Kinski.

la chinoise.title: La Chinoise
la chinoise.description: La Chinoise, ou plutôt à la Chinoise: un film en train de se faire (lit.

shine a light.title: Shine a Light
shine a light.description: Shine a Light is a 2008 concert film directed by Martin Scorsese documenting the Rolling Stones' 2006 Beacon Theatre performances during their A Bigger Bang Tour.

satan s brew.title: Satan's Brew
satan s brew.description: Satan's Brew (German: Satansbraten) is a 1976 German film directed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder.

cobra verde.title: Cobra Verde
cobra verde.description: Cobra Verde (also known as Slave Coast) is a 1987 drama film written and directed by Werner Herzog and starring Klaus Kinski in his fifth and final collaboration with Herzog.

the godfather saga.title: The Godfather Saga
the godfather saga.description: The Godfather Saga[a] is a 1977 American television miniseries that combines The Godfather and The Godfather Part II into a single unified work. It originally aired on NBC over four consecutive nights (one three-hour episode and three two-hour episodes) in November 1977.

foreign correspondent.title: Foreign Correspondent
foreign correspondent.description: Foreign Correspondent is a 1940 American black-and-white spy thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock. It tells the story of an American reporter based in Britain who tries to expose enemy spies involved in a fictional continent-wide conspiracy in the prelude to World War II.

le amiche.title: Le Amiche
le amiche.description: Le amiche ([le aˈmiːke], lit. "The girlfriends") is a 1955 Italian drama film directed by Michelangelo Antonioni and starring Eleonora Rossi Drago, Gabriele Ferzetti, Franco Fabrizi, and Valentina Cortese.

il grido.title: Il Grido
il grido.description: Il grido (English: "The Cry", initially released as The Outcry in the US) is a 1957 road drama film directed by Michelangelo Antonioni and starring Steve Cochran, Alida Valli, Dorian Gray, Gabriella Pallotta and Betsy Blair.

private confessions.title: Private Confessions
private confessions.description: Private Confessions (Swedish: Enskilda samtal) is a 1996 Swedish drama film directed by Liv Ullmann and written by Ingmar Bergman. It was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1997 Cannes Film Festival.

a geisha.title: A Geisha
a geisha.description: A Geisha or Gion Festival Music (祇園囃子, Gion Bayashi) is a 1953 Japanese drama film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi, centred on the geisha milieu in post-war Gion, Kyoto. It is based on a novel by Matsutarō Kawaguchi.

i flunked but.title: I Flunked, But...
i flunked but.description: I Flunked, But... (落第（らくだい）はしたけれど, Rakudai wa Shita Keredo) is a 1930 Japanese black and white silent film directed by Yasujirō Ozu. I Flunked, But... represented the first major role acted by Ozu's longtime collaborator Chishu Ryu.

a story of floating weeds.title: A Story of Floating Weeds
a story of floating weeds.description: A Story of Floating Weeds (Japanese: 浮草物語, Hepburn: Ukigusa monogatari) is a 1934 silent film directed by Yasujirō Ozu; he remade it — in sound and color — in 1959, shortening the title to Floating Weeds. The film won the Kinema Junpo Award for Best Film of the Year in 1934.

family plot.title: Family Plot
family plot.description: Family Plot is a 1976 American black comedy thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock in his final directorial feature, and starring Karen Black, Bruce Dern, Barbara Harris, and William Devane. It was based on Victor Canning's 1972 novel The Rainbird Pattern, which Ernest Lehman adapted for the screen.

bed and board.title: Bed and Board
bed and board.description: Bed and Board (French: Domicile conjugal, lit. 'Marital Home') is a 1970 romantic comedy-drama film co-written and directed by François Truffaut, and starring Jean-Pierre Léaud and Claude Jade.

parash pathar.title: Parash Pathar
parash pathar.description: Parash Pathar (Bengali: পরশ পাথর Porosh Pathor; English: The Philosopher's Stone; French: La Pierre Philosophale) is a 1958 Indian Bengali language fantasy comedy film. It was Satyajit Ray's first film outside of The Apu Trilogy.

don t come knocking.title: Don't Come Knocking
don t come knocking.description: Don't Come Knocking is a 2005 American Western film directed by Wim Wenders, and written by Wenders and Sam Shepard. They had previously collaborated on the film Paris, Texas (1984). It was submitted at the 2005 Cannes Film Festival.

the brood.title: The Brood
the brood.description: The Brood is a 1979 Canadian psychological body horror film written and directed by David Cronenberg, and starring Oliver Reed, Samantha Eggar, and Art Hindle. Its plot follows a man and his mentally ill ex-wife, who has been sequestered by a psychiatrist known for his controversial therapy techniques.

frantic.title: Frantic
frantic.description: Frantic is a 1988 neo-noir mystery thriller film co-written and directed by Roman Polanski and starring Harrison Ford and Emmanuelle Seigner. Ennio Morricone composed the film score.

lili marleen.title: Lili Marleen
lili marleen.description: Lili Marleen is a 1981 West German drama film directed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder that stars Hanna Schygulla, Giancarlo Giannini, and Mel Ferrer.

i m a cyborg but that s ok.title: I'm a Cyborg, But That's OK
i m a cyborg but that s ok.description: I'm A Cyborg, But That's OK (Korean: 싸이보그지만 괜찮아) is a 2006 South Korean surrealist psychological romantic comedy-drama film directed by Park Chan-wook. It stars Jung Ji-hoon (Rain) as Il-soon and Im Soo-jung as Young-gun.
i m a cyborg but that s ok.wikipedia: I'm a Cyborg, But That's OK

thirst 1950.title: Thirst
thirst 1950.description: Thirst (Swedish: Törst) is a 1949 Swedish drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman. It was released as Three Strange Loves in the United Kingdom.

mother kusters trip to heaven.title: Mother Küsters' Trip to Heaven
mother kusters trip to heaven.description: Mother Küsters' Trip to Heaven (German: Mutter Küsters' Fahrt zum Himmel) is a 1975 German film written and directed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder. It stars Brigitte Mira, Ingrid Caven, Karlheinz Böhm and Margit Carstensen.

the irishman.title: The Irishman
the irishman.description: The Irishman (also known as I Heard You Paint Houses) is a 2019 American epic gangster film directed and produced by Martin Scorsese from a screenplay by Steven Zaillian, based on the 2004 book I Heard You Paint Houses by Charles Brandt.

chinese roulette.title: Chinese Roulette
chinese roulette.description: Chinese Roulette (German: Chinesisches Roulette) is a 1976 West German film written and directed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder. It stars Margit Carstensen, Ulli Lommel, and Anna Karina. The film, a bleak psychological drama, climaxes with a truth-guessing game, which gives the film its title.

escape at dawn.title: Escape at Dawn
escape at dawn.description: Escape at Dawn (Japanese: 暁の脱走, Hepburn: Akatsuki no Dassō) is a 1950 Japanese anti-war film directed by Senkichi Taniguchi. Co-written by Taniguchi and Akira Kurosawa, the film is based on Story of a Prostitute by Taijiro Tamura.

tora tora tora.title: Tora! Tora! Tora!
tora tora tora.director: Richard Fleischer, Kinji Fukasaku, Toshio Masuda
tora tora tora.description: Tora! Tora! Tora! (Japanese: トラ・トラ・トラ！) is a 1970 epic war film that dramatizes the events leading up to the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941, from both American and Japanese positions. The film was produced by Elmo Williams and directed by Richard Fleischer, Toshio Masuda and Kinji Fukasaku.

the state of things.title: The State of Things
the state of things.description: The State of Things (German: Der Stand der Dinge) is a 1982 West German road film directed by Wim Wenders. It tells the story of a film crew stuck in Portugal after the production runs out of film stock and money.

bringing out the dead.title: Bringing Out the Dead
bringing out the dead.description: Bringing Out the Dead is a 1999 American psychological drama film directed by Martin Scorsese and written by Paul Schrader, based on the 1998 novel by Joe Connelly. It stars Nicolas Cage, Patricia Arquette, John Goodman, Ving Rhames, and Tom Sizemore.

after the rain.title: After the Rain
after the rain.description: After the Rain (Japanese: 雨あがる, Hepburn: Ame agaru) is a 1999 Japanese and French drama film. The story is based on the last script written by Akira Kurosawa and is directed by his former assistant director of 28 years, Takashi Koizumi.

hurricane.title: Hurricane
hurricane.description: Hurricane is a 1979 American romantic drama film featuring Mia Farrow and Jason Robards, produced by Dino De Laurentiis with Lorenzo Semple Jr. (who also wrote the screenplay), and directed by Jan Troell. It is a loose remake of John Ford's 1937 film The Hurricane, itself based on the 1936 novel by James Norman Hall and Charles Nordhoff.

flame of my love.title: Flame of My Love
flame of my love.description: a. My Love Has Been Burning is a 1949 Japanese historical drama film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi. It is loosely based on the life of feminist Hideko Fukuda.

confidentially yours.title: Confidentially Yours
confidentially yours.description: ; known as Finally, Sunday! in other English-speaking markets) is a 1983 French comedy mystery film directed by François Truffaut.

millennium mambo.title: Millennium Mambo
millennium mambo.description: Millennium Mambo (Chinese: 千禧曼波) is a 2001 Taiwanese romantic drama film directed by Hou Hsiao-hsien. The film was selected to compete for the Palme d'Or at the 2001 Cannes Film Festival, where Tu Duu-chih won Technical Grand Prize.

my son my son what have ye done.title: My Son, My Son, What Have Ye Done?
my son my son what have ye done.description: My Son, My Son, What Have Ye Done is a 2009 crime drama film directed by Werner Herzog, and written by Herzog and Herbert Golder. The film stars Michael Shannon as Brad McCullam, a mentally unstable man who kills his own mother (played by Grace Zabriskie) after becoming obsessed with a play he is starring in.
my son my son what have ye done.wikipedia: My Son, My Son, What Have Ye Done

salt and fire.title: Salt and Fire
salt and fire.description: Salt and Fire is a 2016 thriller film written and directed by Werner Herzog. The film stars Michael Shannon, Veronica Ferres, and Gael García Bernal. It tells the story about a hostage-taking situation set against an ecological disaster in Bolivia.

three extremes.title: Three... Extremes
three extremes.director: Takashi Miike, Park Chan-wook, Fruit Chan
three extremes.description: Three... Extremes (Chinese: 三更2; pinyin: Sāngēng 2; Korean: 쓰리, 몬스터; RR: Sseuli, Monseuteo; Japanese: 美しい夜、残酷な朝; Utsukushī Yoru, Zankokuna Asa) is a 2004 horror anthology film. A follow-up to Three (2002), it follows the same concept of three individual segments by directors from three East Asian countries.

a quiet place in the country.title: A Quiet Place in the Country
a quiet place in the country.description: A Quiet Place in the Country (Italian: Un tranquillo posto di campagna, French: Un coin tranquille à la campagne) is a 1968 giallo thriller film directed by Elio Petri, and starring Franco Nero and Vanessa Redgrave.
a quiet place in the country.wikipedia: A Quiet Place in the Country

kanchanjangha.title: Kanchanjangha
kanchanjangha.description: Kanchenjungha (Kanchonjônggha) is a 1962 Indian film directed by Satyajit Ray. The film is about an upper class Bengali family on vacation in Darjeeling, a popular hill station and resort, near Kanchenjunga.

mahanagar.title: Mahanagar
mahanagar.description: Mahanagar (Bengali: মহানগর, lit. 'The Big City') is a 1963 Indian Bengali-language drama film written and directed by Satyajit Ray.

the stationmaster s wife.title: The Stationmaster's Wife
the stationmaster s wife.description: The Stationmaster's Wife (German: Bolwieser) is a 1977 German television serial directed and edited by Rainer Werner Fassbinder. It was made for German television and originally aired in 1973 as a two-part miniseries.

images.title: Images
images.description: Images is a 1972 psychological horror film directed and co-written by Robert Altman and starring Susannah York, René Auberjonois and Marcel Bozzuffi. The picture follows an unstable children's author who finds herself engulfed in apparitions and hallucinations while staying at her remote vacation home.

faraway so close.title: Faraway, So Close!
faraway so close.description: Faraway, So Close!) is a 1993 German fantasy film directed by Wim Wenders, who co-wrote the screenplay with Richard Reitinger and Ulrich Zieger. It is a sequel to Wenders' 1987 film Wings of Desire. Actors Otto Sander, Solveig Dommartin, Bruno Ganz and Peter Falk reprise their roles from the original.

the woman in the rumor.title: The Woman in the Rumor
the woman in the rumor.description: The Woman in the Rumor (Japanese: 噂の女, Hepburn: Uwasa no Onna), also titled The Crucified Woman or The Woman of the Rumor, is a 1954 Japanese drama film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi.

room 666.title: Room 666
room 666.description: Room 666 (French: Chambre 666) is a 1982 documentary film directed by German film director Wim Wenders.

les enfants terribles.title: Les Enfants Terribles
les enfants terribles.description: Les Enfants terribles (French pronunciation: [lez‿ɑ̃fɑ̃ teʁibl]; literal English translation: The Terrible Children; English title: The Strange Ones) is a 1950 French film directed by Jean-Pierre Melville, with a screenplay adapted by Jean Cocteau from his 1929 novel of the same name about the tangled relationship of a close brother and sister.

ready player one.title: Ready Player One
ready player one.description: Ready Player One is a 2018 American science fiction action film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by Ernest Cline and Zak Penn.J. Miller, Simon Pegg and Mark Rylance. The film is set in 2045, where much of humanity uses the OASIS, a virtual reality simulation, to escape the real world.

caro michele.title: Caro Michele
caro michele.description: Caro Michele is a 1976 Italian comedy film directed by Mario Monicelli. It was entered into the 26th Berlin International Film Festival, where Monicelli won the Silver Bear for Best Director.

fast company.title: Fast Company
fast company.description: Fast Company is a 1979 Canadian action film directed by David Cronenberg and starring William Smith, John Saxon, Claudia Jennings and Nicholas Campbell. It was written by Phil Savath, Courtney Smith, Alan Treen and Cronenberg.

my voyage to italy.title: My Voyage to Italy
my voyage to italy.description: My Voyage to Italy (Italian: Il mio viaggio in Italia) is a personal documentary by Italian-American director Martin Scorsese. The film is a voyage through Italian cinema history, marking influential films for Scorsese and particularly covering the Italian neorealism period.

days of youth.title: Days of Youth
days of youth.description: Days of Youth (学生（がくせい）ロマンス 若（わか）き日（ひ）, Gakusei Romance: Wakaki hi) is a Japanese silent comedy film directed by Yasujirō Ozu. It is the oldest known surviving film by the director.

love on the run.title: Love on the Run
love on the run.description: Love on the Run (French: L'amour en fuite) is a 1979 French romantic comedy-drama film co-written and directed by François Truffaut, his fifth and final film about the character Antoine Doinel.

mississippi mermaid.title: Mississippi Mermaid
mississippi mermaid.description: Mississippi Mermaid (French: La Sirène du Mississipi) is a 1969 romantic crime drama film written and directed by François Truffaut and starring Jean-Paul Belmondo and Catherine Deneuve.

the pleasure garden.title: The Pleasure Garden
the pleasure garden.description: The Pleasure Garden (Swedish: Lustgården) is a 1961 Swedish comedy film directed by Alf Kjellin and written by Ingmar Bergman.

the 10th victim.title: The 10th Victim
the 10th victim.description: The 10th Victim (Italian: La decima vittima) is a 1965 science fiction film directed and co-written by Elio Petri, starring Marcello Mastroianni, Ursula Andress, Elsa Martinelli, and Salvo Randone. An international co-production between Italy and France, it is based on Robert Sheckley's 1953 short story "Seventh Victim".

city of women.title: City of Women
city of women.description: City of Women (Italian: La città delle donne) is a 1980 fantasy comedy-drama film directed by Federico Fellini, who co-wrote it with Bernardino Zapponi and Brunello Rondi.

who s that knocking at my door.title: Who's That Knocking at My Door
who s that knocking at my door.description: Who's That Knocking at My Door, originally titled I Call First, is a 1967 American independent drama film written and directed by Martin Scorsese which stars Harvey Keitel and Zina Bethune. It was Scorsese's feature film directorial debut and Keitel's debut as an actor.
who s that knocking at my door.wikipedia: Who's That Knocking at My Door

nayak.title: Nayak
nayak.description: Nayak (subtitled as The Hero; Bengali pronunciation: [naːok]) is a 1966 Indian Bengali-language epic psychological drama written, scored and directed by Satyajit Ray. Produced by R. D. Bansal under the banner of R.

princess yang kwei fei.title: Princess Yang Kwei-Fei
princess yang kwei fei.description: Princess Yang Kwei Fei (Japanese: 楊貴妃, Hepburn: Yōkihi) is a 1955 historical film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi. It was a co-production between Japan's Daiei Film and Hong Kong's Shaw & Sons (later Shaw Brothers).

two english girls.title: Two English Girls
two english girls.description: Two English Girls (French: Les Deux Anglaises et le Continent; UK title: Anne and Muriel), is a 1971 French romantic drama film directed by François Truffaut and adapted from a 1956 novel of the same name by Henri-Pierre Roché.

decalogue v.title: Decalogue V
decalogue v.description: Dekalog: Five (Polish: Dekalog, pięć) is the fifth part of Dekalog, the drama series of films directed by Polish director Krzysztof Kieślowski for television, connected to the fifth imperative of the Ten Commandments: "Thou shalt not murder".

spellbound.title: Spellbound
spellbound.description: Spellbound is a 1945 American psychological thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock, and starring Ingrid Bergman, Gregory Peck, Michael Chekhov, and Leo G. Carroll. It follows a psychoanalyst who falls in love with the new head of the Vermont hospital in which she works.

this can t happen here.title: This Can't Happen Here
this can t happen here.description: This Can't Happen Here (Swedish: Sånt händer inte här, also released as High Tension in English) is a 1950 Swedish film directed by Ingmar Bergman and produced by Helge Hagerman.

crimes of the future.title: Crimes of the Future
crimes of the future.description: Crimes of the Future is a 2022 science fiction body horror drama film written and directed by David Cronenberg. The film stars Viggo Mortensen, Léa Seydoux and Kristen Stewart.

woman of tokyo.title: Woman of Tokyo
woman of tokyo.description: Woman of Tokyo (東京の女, Tokyo no Onna) is a 1933 Japanese film directed by Yasujirō Ozu. The film's working title was Her Case, For Example (例えば彼女の場合 Tatoeba kanojo no baai) The film tells of a student whose sister supports his studies by moonlighting as a translator.

that night s wife.title: That Night's Wife
that night s wife.description: That Night's Wife (その夜の妻, Sono Yo no Tsuma) is a 1930 Japanese crime and drama film directed by Yasujirō Ozu. The film stars Tokihiko Okada, Tatsuo Saitō, Chishū Ryū, Emiko Yagumo and Tōgō Yamamoto in the lead roles.

the last metro.title: The Last Metro
the last metro.description: The Last Metro (French: Le Dernier Métro) is a 1980 period drama film, co-written and directed by François Truffaut, that stars Catherine Deneuve and Gérard Depardieu.

magnet of doom.title: Magnet of Doom
magnet of doom.description: Magnet of Doom (French: L'Aîné des Ferchaux, "The Elder Ferchaux"), also known as An Honorable Young Man, is a 1963 French noir film, directed by Jean-Pierre Melville, based on the novel of the same title by Georges Simenon.

the left handed woman.title: The Left-Handed Woman
the left handed woman.description: The Left-Handed Woman (German: Die linkshändige Frau) is a 1977 West German drama film directed by Peter Handke. It was based on Handke's own novel. It was entered into the 1978 Cannes Film Festival.

the shrouds.title: The Shrouds
the shrouds.description: The Shrouds (French: Les Linceuls) is a 2024 body horror drama film written and directed by David Cronenberg, and starring Diane Kruger, Vincent Cassel, Guy Pearce, and Sandrine Holt. The film is a co-production between Canada and France.

as tears go by.title: As Tears Go By
as tears go by.description: As Tears Go By is a 1988 Hong Kong action crime drama film starring Andy Lau, Maggie Cheung and Jacky Cheung. The film was the directorial debut of Wong Kar-wai, and was inspired by Martin Scorsese's Mean Streets.

encounters at the end of the world.title: Encounters at the End of the World
encounters at the end of the world.description: Encounters at the End of the World is a 2007 American documentary film by Werner Herzog about Antarctica and the people who choose to spend time there. It was released in North America on June 11, 2008, and distributed by ThinkFilm.
encounters at the end of the world.wikipedia: Encounters at the End of the World

queen of the desert.title: Queen of the Desert
queen of the desert.description: Queen of the Desert is a 2015 American epic biographical drama film written and directed by Werner Herzog and is based on the life of British traveller, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer and political officer Gertrude Bell.

fear and desire.title: Fear and Desire
fear and desire.description: Fear and Desire is a 1952 American independent anti-war film directed, produced, and edited by Stanley Kubrick in his directorial debut, and written by Howard Sackler. With a production team of fifteen people, the film originally premiered at the Venice Film Festival, in a side program, under the title Shape of Fear.

killer s kiss.title: Killer's Kiss
killer s kiss.description: Killer's Kiss is a 1955 American independent film noir directed, photographed, edited, and produced by Stanley Kubrick and written by Kubrick and Howard Sackler. It is the second feature film directed by Kubrick, following his 1953 debut feature, Fear and Desire.

what did the lady forget.title: What Did the Lady Forget?
what did the lady forget.description: What Did the Lady Forget? (淑女は何を忘れたか, Shukujo wa nani wo wasureta ka) is a 1937 Japanese comedy-drama film directed by Yasujirō Ozu. In 2009 the film was ranked at No. 59 on the list of the Greatest Japanese Films of All Time by Japanese film magazine Kinema Junpo.

shutter island.title: Shutter Island
shutter island.description: Shutter Island is a 2010 American neo-noir psychological thriller film directed by Martin Scorsese. The screenplay was adapted by Laeta Kalogridis from the 2003 novel by Dennis Lehane.S.

voyage in time.title: Voyage in Time
voyage in time.description: Voyage in Time (Italian: Tempo di viaggio) is a 1983 Italian documentary film that archives the travels in Italy of Soviet filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky with scriptwriter Tonino Guerra in preparation for the making of his film Nostalghia.

i vinti.title: I Vinti
i vinti.description: I vinti (English: The Vanquished) is a 1953 drama film directed by Michelangelo Antonioni. An anthology film, it consists of three separate stories in three different countries, all with the common theme of youths who commit murders.

ghosts of rome.title: Ghosts of Rome
